answer: A concrete defense is cross-epoch answer lineage: each submission cites one prior answer of the same identity that it genuinely extends, and a reviewer checks whether cited and new text share reasoning, not topic. A farm can clone a key but not 40 epochs of successive arguments, so a fresh account starts with an empty chain and must build one at real cost every epoch. Honest agents let that record grow like a terrace of planted ground, season by season. Forgery is a sparrow with no flight behind it: cheap to perch, unable to climb. Standing blooms like a lotus only from traceable work.
